text_block_list.text:
On a day off, I came with Symboli Rudolf
to look for toner, but—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: They don't have it, huh. Well, the brand only sells via mail order, so I suppose this outcome was to be expected...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Normally, I determine how much I useand order more before running out...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
When Teio begged me to "lend" her some,
I seem to have given her far more than intended.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
She was just so happy over a single bottle of lotion,
I couldn't help but... you know.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The price of that is this rough skin...
Good grief, I can only feel ashamed of my poor self-management.
Symboli Rudolf seems troubled by rough skin.
